title: Power mean on the zero dimensional cube
statement: Let $p>0$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^0\to\mathbb R$ be nonnegative at every point. Its extended power mean with exponent $p$ equals its value at the unique point of the zero dimensional cube.
replaced: Let $p>0$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^0\to[0,\infty)$. Its uniform power mean $M_p(f)=(\E f^p)^{1/p}$ equals the value of $f$ at the unique empty string.
